name: Femto
summary: Femto is a legacy iToF RGB-D camera with onboard depth processing and USB-C connectivity. It supplies depth data for 3D tracking, reconstruction and perception, including manufacturer-documented cleaning-robot applications. Marketing ended in September 2025.

sources.quote:
EOL No.: EOL_20250220003
EOL Announcement for Femto & Femto W
Dear customers:
In order to better assist you in addressing market changes and the challenges of technological
innovation, Orbbec Optical has provided the key lifecycle milestone points for the Femto & Femto
W . We hope this information will serve as a reference for your future product planning and
development.
Orbbec Inc.
February 20, 2025
Milestone Date Remark
EOL announcement 2025-02-20 EOL publicity date
EOM 2025-09-30
End of Marketing. The EOM date is the date
when the product stops accepting orders,
including orders for new sites and capacity
expansion. After that date, the product will no
longer be sold.
EOS 2027-09-30
End of Service & Support. It refers to the last
date of the service. After the EOS date, Orbbec
does not provide any service for the product.
Including software and hardware problem
support and update.
Replacement product
End of Life product Replacement product
Femto Femto Bolt
Femto W Femto Bolt
